As an Indian national, you don't have visa-free access to Vietnam, and a 4-month (120-day) stay is actually too long for the standard e-Visa, which only covers up to 90 days. So for this trip you'll need an embassy/consulate visa rather than the e-Visa.

- **Pathway needed:** Embassy/consulate visa (apply through a Vietnamese embassy or consulate before you travel), in whatever category fits your purpose of visit (e.g. LV for work, DT for investment, GD for study/education-related stays, etc.). The standard tourist e-Visa tops out at 90 days, so it can't cover a 120-day stay.
- **If you can shorten the trip to 90 days or less:** you'd qualify for the e-Visa instead — apply at evisa.gov.vn, valid for stays up to 90 days, costs USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry), processing takes about 2-3 business days (faster options available for a fee), and it's usable at any of Vietnam's ~83 approved entry ports (air, land, or sea) — it doesn't lock you to one specific port.
- **Passport validity:** must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date, regardless of which route you take.
- **Data caveat:** this is based on policy data as of 2026-08-17. Visa rules can change, so please verify current requirements at https://evisa.gov.vn/ or with a Vietnamese embassy/consulate before booking your trip.
